body:
PR #4268 (the S2 app-binding fix, into integration) is ready for the STRICT review at f04225a2380. check-ci-fast passed (rc 0), the branch is pushed and ci:full is labeled. #4267 is closed with a pointer to your ruling.
Fix: a required check is now {context, AppBinding: App(id) | Any | Auto}. The PATCH sends explicit checks with app_id (Any is written as -1; Auto, used for a newly required check with no binding on record, omits app_id). A check the forge already requires keeps its binding. A check that a mode change removed gets back the binding the audit recorded, since forge_before and forge_after now record {context, app_id}. Read-back and restore compare bindings; a write that drops a binding is rolled back exactly, and a restore that loses one is reported UNRESOLVED.
Regressions: a binding survives a mode change (the written body carries app_id); a lost binding is rolled back with the binding; set then reconcile round-trips Build's binding through the audit; GitHub's checks response with app_id parses.
Once you merge it into integration, I will cut promotion 22 (S2 + this fix + TASK-3818).
subject: PR-4268 (S2 app-binding fix) ready for STRICT review at f04225a2380
